title_working: In This World, You Can See How Much Luck You Have Left
world_rule: Everyone has a glowing luck number on the chest, and luck is never free: it is moved from someone else.
logline: A boy's best day ever is paid for by his own mother's luck.

lines.text: In this world, you can see how much luck you have left.
lines.say: (confident) In this world, you can see how much luck you have left.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Everyone has a glowing number on their chest. Green means good luck. Red means bad luck.
lines.say: (happy) Everyone has a glowing number on their chest. Green means good luck. Red means bad luck.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: One morning, a boy named Noel woke up to a blinding green one thousand.
lines.say: (happy) One morning, a boy named Noel woke up to a blinding green one thousand.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: He ran outside and had the best day of his life.
lines.say: (happy) He ran outside and had the best day of his life.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: He found one hundred dollars on the sidewalk.
lines.say: (happy) He found one hundred dollars on the sidewalk.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Strangers smiled and gave him compliments.
lines.say: (happy) Strangers smiled and gave him compliments.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Then someone handed him the keys to a brand new car, for free.
lines.say: (surprised) Then someone handed him the keys to a brand new car, for free.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Every time something good happened, a number somewhere else turned red. Noel never looked.
lines.say: (nervous) Every time something good happened, a number somewhere else turned red. Noel never looked.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Late that night, he finally went home.
lines.say: (soft tone) Late that night, he finally went home.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: The moment he stepped inside, his chest flashed red. Minus one million.
lines.say: (surprised) The moment he stepped inside, his chest flashed red. Minus one million.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: His heart pounded. His little sister was crying on the kitchen floor.
lines.say: (sad) His heart pounded. His little sister was crying on the kitchen floor.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: And his mother lay beside her, clutching her chest.
lines.say: (sad) And his mother lay beside her, clutching her chest.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: That is when he understood. The system never gives free luck.
lines.say: (sad) That is when he understood. The system never gives free luck.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: It only moves it from someone else.
lines.say: (soft tone) It only moves it from someone else.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: And Noel had taken every drop from his own mother.
lines.say: (sad) And Noel had taken every drop from his own mother.
lines.speaker: narrator
